tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250g.yang 'gugs mdor bsdus ni/ 1$0000300kyai/ tshogs gnyis nor bu rgyas pa'i sprin chen las// dge legs 'dod dgu'i gru char 'jo ba yis// sa gsum skye rgu'i re ba skong mdzad pa'i// rtsa gsum nor lha'i tshogs rnams dgongs su gsol// de ring bkra shis lha yi nyi ma la// phywa cha g.yang rdzas ma lus bkram nas kyang*// rten 'brel cho ga zab mo 'di bgyid na// thugs dam ma bsnyel 'dod 'bras mchis par mdzod// chos nyid bsam mi khyab pa'i bden stobs dang*// chos can rgyu 'bras rten 'byung bslu med mthus// srid zhi'i khams kyi phywa g.yang dpal 'byor bcud// de ring bkra shis gnas 'dir myur du khug /'chi med tshe dang rgas med lang tsho'i dpal// 'dzad med nor dang rnam dpyod blo gros phul// phun tshogs sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor ji snyed pa// de ring bkra shis g.yang ra 'di ru khug /sangs rgyas byang sems bstan 'dzin 'phags rnams kyi// byin rlabs thugs rje nus pa'i mthu stobs dang*// lung rtogs bshad sgrub snying po'i phrin las rgyun// ma lus de ring bkra shis gnas 'dir khug /'byung ba nyi zla ri gling rtsi shing sman// bum bzang dpag bsam gter dang ma rmos tshal// lha klu mi yi dpal 'byor phun tshogs bcud// ji snyed mchis kun de ring g.yang du khug /snod la g.yang chags rtsi sman lo tog rgyas// bcud la dpal gnas tshe ring mdangs stobs ldan// rgyal bstan dar rgyas bstan 'dzin dbu 'phang mtho// don gnyis bsam kun 'grub pa'i bkra shis stsol//

ces 'phags nor gyi grangs kyis mdzes pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di'ang rgyal sras gzhan phan chos kyi blo gros kyis zhe chen rgyal tshab padma rnam rgyal rin po che/bris pa dge legs su gyur cig// / ༈ dpe tshan 'di sngon chad gter mdzod dkyus su med cing*/ bal yul zhe dgon gyi par gsar 'dir gsar bzhag byas pas lung rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no//
